name: Crystallize
body:
School transmutation; Level sorcerer/wizard 6

CASTING

Casting Time 1 minute
Components V, S, M (a gem worth at least 200 gp)

EFFECT

Range close (10 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one willing subject and up to 200 lbs. of equipment
Duration permanent; see text
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

The target becomes encased in magical crystal and petrified. The crystal has a hardness of 10, and can take 500 hit points of damage before releasing its petrified contents unharmed. The crystal breaks automatically and the subject’s petrified condition ends upon the successful application of a stone to flesh spell, or when specific conditions stated at the time of casting are met. This spell has no effect on unwilling subjects.
